Messages.Author: Mike Ooi
Messages.Body:
Most exclusive political actions are defined on the card. For example, votes
which state "Requires a ready Prince or Justicar" means that only a Prince
or Justicar can take the action to call the vote. A Sabbat Cardinal cannot
call Anathema or Parity Shift, for example.

The only Political actions which limit who can vote in the referendum (as
defined by card text) are Investiture (turns a Sabbat into a Priscus) and
Cardinal Benediction (turns a Sabbat over 6 into a Cardinal). Of course,
using Closed Session prohibits all non Camarilla from having votes during
the referendum.

When the Sabbat first came out, the accompanying rulebook stated several
political actions which Sabbat vampires could not take that were not defined
by the card text (for example, Command of the Harpies - which states it can
be called by any vampire). Whether those rules still hold (as several of
those rules were revised, including the Prince/Archbishop of X auto-rush
feature) is a question for LSJ.

-Mike

P.S. It's fun to use Hannibal to make one of your Camarilla weenies a
Justicar. Tee hee.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <39957621...@hotmail.com>, Chris Shorb
<ultima...@hotmail.com> writes

>Another angle you might also want to add is whether the vote to burn the
>Elysium Arboretum can be called by Cam/Sab/Ind. I believe only Cam can
>call it,

Correct. Section 10 - Vampire Sects:

Only Camarilla vampires can use the Camarilla power structure
respresented by some cards and actions. To reflect this, those cards and
actions that are related to this power structure are restricted, in
addition to the restrictions on titles listed above.

Only Camarilla vampires can call the following referendums: Justicar
Retribution, Command of the Harpies, Masquerade Enforcement, the vote to
burn Masquerade Enforcement, the vote to burn Elysium: the Arboretum,
and the vote to remove the abilities granted by Archon. Only Camarilla
vampires can be chosen in the Archon and Camarilla Exemplary
referendums.

>but all can vote.

Again, correct.

There are no standing limitations (i.e. in the errata or rules) on who
can vote on any given referendum. All such limiting is done by card
text *only* (as the game currently stands).

Everyone can vote on all political actions unless there is specific card
text to the contrary. Closed Session is one such card. There are a
number of cards in the Sabbat set which are similarly limited.

--

James Coupe

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <8n9148$vto$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>, Ramsteiner <ramsteiner@my-
deja.com> writes
>Anarchist Uprising Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call or vote, no errata.

>Anathema Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-Y

Requires Prince or Justicar so implicitly can only be called by
Camarilla vampires - with those titles. Everyone can vote.

>Ancient Influence Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call or vote, no errata. (1 per game)

>Ancilla Empowerment Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call or vote, no errata.

>Archon Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-Y

Archon vote when the political action card is played:
Called by Prince or Justicar so can only be called by Camarilla vampires
with those titles. Everyone can vote. However, a Camarilla vampire
must be chosen to receive the Archon powers (V:TES Section 10)

Archon vote when the Archon powers are removed:
Only called by Camarilla vampires (V:TES Section 10). Everyone can
vote.

>Autarkis Persecution Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call or vote.

>Banishment Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y

Everyone can call or vote.
Errata affects how the card interacts with cards already on a vampire,
but not the actual "Banishment" of the vampire.

>Beyond Reproach Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N

Can only be called by a Prince so requires a Camarilla vampire who is a
Prince. Everyone can vote.

>Camarilla Exemplary Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N
> (Card makes no indication of Camarilla Only other than by it’s

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.
However, only a Camarilla vampire can be targeted by the vote. (V:TES
Section 10)

>Camarilla Threat Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Cardinal Benediction N-N-Y-Y-N-N-N

Only Sabbat vampires can vote, and there are capacity limitations on the
target of the vote.
Camarilla vampires cannot vote - so Independent and Sabbat vampires only
for voting.

>(Camarilla Clan) Justicar Y-Y-N-N-N-N-N (Y – Ventrue)

Venture Justicar is re-written to be Ventrue Justicar for the Ventrue
clan, following the same template as every other Justicar card.

Anyone can call them, anyone can vote in them. However, only a vampire
of the relevant clan can be targeted by the vote. Vampires of the
relevant clan get additional votes, but no-one is excluded from voting.

>Code of Milan Suspended N-Y-Y-Y-N-Y-Y

Called only by Sabbat vampires, but everyone can vote.
Errata works to the effect that the Methuselah with the edge when the
vote is called burns the pool - else you could burn the edge during the
referendum to gain a vote, and escape the effects.

>Command of the Harpies Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N
> (Card make no indication of Camarilla Only other than by it’s
>Title.)

Only Camarilla vampires can call (V:TES Section 10). However, all
vampires can vote.

>Consanguineous Boon Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Every can call, everyone can vote.

>Consanguineous Condem Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Conservative Agitation Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Corruption's Purge Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N

Requires a Prince, Justicar or Inner Circle member so implicitly
requires a vampire with those titles who is a member of the Camarilla.
Everyone can vote.

>Crusade: (City Name) Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N

Can only be called by Sabbat vampires, by card text.
Everyone can vote.

>Cunctator Motion Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Disputed Territory Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y

Everyone can call and everyone can vote.
Clarifications exist to note that it *is* a political action, despite it
not having the symbol on the card. Also, there are rulings elsewhere on
moving locquipment via Disputed Territory and also noting that you don't
need a Gangrel, say, to steal Backways etc.

>Domain Challenge Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y

Can be called by everyone. Errata notes that the tapped vampires are
only counted after the referendum (e.g. for when playing Disarming
Presence).

>Dramatic Upheaval Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Excommunication N-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N

Only Sabbat vampires can call, and an Archbishop must be the target.
However, everyone can vote.

>1st Trad: The Masquerade Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N

Requires a Prince or Justicar, so needs a Camarilla vampire with those
votes. However, everyone can vote on this referendum.

>Giovanni Acceptance Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>High Stakes Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Requires a ready Ventrue, so only Ventrue can call the vote. However, a
Ventrue who was not also a member of the Camarilla *could* call the
vote. There is currently, to the best of my knowledge, no way to get an
Independent or Sabbat Ventrue *but* were a reverse "Writ of Acceptance"
(Stamp of Disapproval?) type card invented, a non-Camarilla Ventrue
could call this vote.

Currently, only Ventrue (and hence Camarilla) vampires can call this
vote. Everyone is entitled to vote.

>Investiture N-Y-Y-Y-N-Y-N

Only called by Cardinal vampires - hence only by members of the Sabbat.
Camarilla vampires are unable to vote.
Cardinals get one additional vote. All Sabbat and Independent members
can vote.

>Invitation Accepted Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Justicar Retribution Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y

This vote can only be called by Camarilla vampires (V:TES Section 10).
However, all vampires may vote. The errata notes that the amount of
bleed used is the amount of bleed versus its prey.

>Kindred Restructure Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N

Requires a Prince or Justicar, so requires a Camarilla (implicitly)
Prince or Justicar.
All vampires may vote.

>Kindred Segregation Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Kine Resources Contested Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Legacy of Pander N-Y-Y-Y-N-Y-Y

Playing Legacy: Only Sabbat vampires can call the vote, but everyone is
entitled to vote.

Burning Legacy: Only Sabbat vampires can burn Legacy (I think, the card
text file seems to be a bit weird, regarding (D) actions, so it may be
wrong)

>Lextalionis Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.

>Malkavian Justicar Y-Y-N-Y-N-Y-N

Covered earlier, but everyone can call, everyone can vote, only
Malkavians may be targetted and all Malkavians get additional votes.

>Mark of the Damned Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-Y-N

Everyone can call, everyone can vote.
